<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/><meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" name="viewport"/>
<title>Selamat Datang di Catalog Pincredible</title>
<style>
:root{--pink:#fff1a8;--rose:#ffc928;--deep:#171717;--plum:#111111;--cream:#fffdf5;--lav:#fff4c2;--ink:#292929}
*{box-sizing:border-box}html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:"Trebuchet MS",Arial,sans-serif}
body:before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:-1;background:radial-gradient(circle at 10% 12%,#fff1a8 0 2px,transparent 3px),radial-gradient(circle at 90% 30%,#ffe88a 0 2px,transparent 3px),linear-gradient(135deg,#fffaf6,#fff9df 55%,#fffdf5);background-size:44px 44px,57px 57px,cover}
header{padding:22px 6vw 10px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center}.brand img{display:block;width:190px;max-width:42vw;height:auto;object-fit:contain}.brand span{display:block;font:12px Arial;letter-spacing:4px;color:#bd7e9f;text-align:center;margin-top:2px}
nav{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}nav a{color:var(--deep);text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;font-weight:bold}
.hero{max-width:1120px;margin:12px auto 26px;padding:44px 22px 38px;text-align:center;position:relative}
.kicker{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:4px;color:#8b6a00;text-transform:uppercase}
h1{font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,52px);line-height:1.12;color:var(--plum);margin:13px 0}
.hero p{max-width:690px;margin:0 auto;color:#80677a;line-height:1.8;font-size:14px}
.decor{position:absolute;color:#c49a00;font-size:24px;opacity:.8}.d1{left:8%;top:26px}.d2{right:9%;top:45px}.d3{right:16%;bottom:15px;font-size:18px}
.pill{display:inline-block;margin-top:20px;background:#ffed9b;color:#292929;padding:9px 17px;border-radius:99px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px}
.wrap{max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:0 22px 48px}
.section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:14px;margin:22px 0 16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
h2{font: bold 25px Georgia,serif;color:var(--plum);margin:0}.sub{font-size:12px;color:#987b8e;margin-top:6px}
.filters{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:15px 0 20px}
.filter{border:1px solid #a8dff0;background:#fff;color:#27566a;padding:9px 15px;border-radius:30px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px}
.filter.active,.filter:hover{background:#171717;color:white;border-color:#171717}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:17px;min-height:120px}
.item{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e9d98f;border-radius:19px;padding:13px;box-shadow:0 7px 20px #00000012;position:relative;transition:.2s}
.item:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 12px 24px #00000020}
.pinbox{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff9df,#fff1b8);border-radius:14px;aspect-ratio:1;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden}
.pinbox img{width:90%;height:90%;object-fit:contain;filter:drop-shadow(0 5px 5px #00000020)}
.item h3{font: bold 15px Georgia,serif;color:#242424;margin:12px 0 5px}
.meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:11px;color:#776a3a}
.price{font-weight:bold;color:#171717;font-size:13px;margin-top:9px}
.status{display:inline-block;border:0;border-radius:30px;padding:7px 11px;background:#e9f5df;color:#42612f;font-size:10px;font-weight:bold;cursor:pointer;margin-top:10px}
.status.sold{background:#fff0a8;color:#765700;text-decoration:line-through}
.hint{font-size:10px;color:#8c7a37;margin-top:6px}
.about{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.3fr;gap:22px;align-items:center;background:#fff;border:1px solid #e9d98f;border-radius:22px;padding:22px;margin-top:50px}
.about-photo{width:100%;max-height:300px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 35%;border-radius:16px}
.about h2{margin-bottom:10px}.about p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;color:#806b7a}
.team{margin-top:48px}.teamgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-top:18px}
.kevin-card{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;text-align:left;min-height:130px}
.avatar{width:94px;height:94px;flex:0 0 94px;margin:0;border-radius:50%;background:#dff6ff;border:3px solid white;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #a8dff0;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;color:#8b6a00;font-size:28px}
.avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 28%}
.profile-copy strong,.member-name strong{font: bold 15px Georgia,serif;color:#72536b}
.profile-copy small,.member-name small{display:block;color:#776a3a;font-size:11px;margin-top:5px}
.friends-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:14px;padding:18px 24px}
.member-name{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:left}
.member-mark{width:34px;height:34px;flex:0 0 34px;border-radius:50%;background:#dff6ff;color:#246078;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:17px}
.person-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #a8dff0;border-radius:18px;padding:16px;text-align:center}
.avatar{width:115px;height:115px;margin:0 auto 12px;border-radius:50%;background:#dff6ff;border:3px solid white;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #a8dff0;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden;color:#8b6a00;font-size:28px}
.avatar{width:94px;height:94px;flex:0 0 94px;margin:0}.avatar img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 28%}.person-card strong{font: bold 14px Georgia,serif;color:#72536b}.person-card small{display:block;color:#776a3a;font-size:11px;margin-top:5px}
.gallery{margin-top:48px}.gallerygrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:13px;margin-top:18px}
.gallery-slot{aspect-ratio:1.15;background:#fff;border:1px dashed #d8bd54;border-radius:17px;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;color:#776a3a;font-size:12px;padding:14px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.gallery-slot img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;position:absolute;inset:0}.gallery-slot input{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;width:100%}
.preorder{margin:48px 0 20px;text-align:center;padding:30px 15px;background:#fff1b8;border-radius:22px}
.preorder h2{margin-bottom:9px}.preorder p{font-size:13px;color:#625526}
.cta{display:inline-block;background:#76516a;color:white;text-decoration:none;border-radius:30px;padding:12px 23px;font-size:12px;margin-top:8px;letter-spacing:.5px}
footer{text-align:center;padding:28px 18px;color:#292929;font-size:12px;background:#fff1b8;margin-top:20px}footer .hearts{font-size:17px;color:#c49a00;margin-bottom:7px}
.sticker{position:fixed;right:17px;bottom:15px;color:#c49a00;font-size:20px;opacity:.65;pointer-events:none}

.studio-feature{max-width:1120px;margin:8px auto 34px;padding:0 22px;position:relative}
.studio-feature img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #a8dff0;box-shadow:0 8px 24px #28718a18}
.studio-caption{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;background:#fff2a6;color:#171717;padding:11px 16px;border-radius:0 0 14px 14px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.5px}
.studio-caption strong{font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1.5px}
@media(max-width:600px){.studio-feature{padding:0 12px;margin:8px auto 24px}.studio-caption{font-size:10px;padding:9px 11px}}
@media(max-width:850px){.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:600px){header{justify-content:center}nav{justify-content:center}.hero{padding:30px 18px}.grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px}.item{padding:9px}.about{grid-template-columns:1fr}.about-photo{max-height:250px}.teamgrid{gap:8px}.person-card{padding:10px 8px}.kevin-card{gap:8px}.avatar{width:72px;height:72px;flex-basis:72px}.friends-card{gap:9px;padding:12px 10px}.member-name{gap:7px}.member-mark{width:27px;height:27px;flex-basis:27px}.gallerygrid{gap:8px}}
.collection-title{max-width:1120px;margin:26px 0 18px;padding:15px 18px;background:#fff1a6;border:1px solid #eadb8a;border-radius:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#171717;box-shadow:0 5px 14px #8a7b3512}
.collection-title-main{font-size:clamp(19px,3vw,25px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:2.5px}
.collection-title-sub{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.5px;color:#5c563c}
@media(max-width:600px){.collection-title{margin:20px 0 14px;padding:13px 15px}.collection-title-main{font-size:19px}.collection-title-sub{font-size:11px}}

.pinbox{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fff8d7,#fff0a8)!important}
.item .price{font-size:15px;font-weight:800}
.status{padding:8px 14px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2px}

#productGrid .pinbox img{image-rendering:auto;backface-visibility:hidden;transform:translateZ(0)}

.order-wa{display:block;text-align:center;text-decoration:none;background:#25D366;color:#fff;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.3px;border-radius:22px;padding:9px 7px;margin-top:8px;box-shadow:0 3px 8px #25d36630}
.order-wa:hover,.wa-contact:hover{filter:brightness(.95)}
.wa-contact{display:inline-block;margin:7px 4px 0;padding:10px 15px;border-radius:24px;background:#25D366;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:800}
.cta{background:#25D366}

.band-collection{margin:52px 0 10px;padding:28px 20px;background:#fff7cf;border:1px solid #eadb91;border-radius:24px}
.collection-title{text-align:center;margin:0 0 22px}
.collection-kicker{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:3px;font-weight:bold;color:#8b6a00;margin-bottom:8px}
.collection-title h2{font: bold clamp(24px,4vw,32px) Georgia,serif;color:#171717;margin:0}
.collection-title .sub{font-size:13px;color:#776a3a}
.band-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:15px}
.band-item{min-width:0}
.band-pinbox{background:#171717;border-radius:14px;aspect-ratio:1.18;display:grid;place-items:center;overflow:hidden}
.band-pinbox img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}
@media(max-width:700px){.band-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px}.band-collection{padding:18px 12px}}


.price-guide{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:-8px 0 18px;padding:13px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #eadb91;border-radius:15px}
.price-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:9px 15px;border-radius:30px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.4px}
.price-tag b{font-size:14px}
.price-tag.small-price{background:#eaf6ff;color:#245a73;border:1px solid #b8ddec}
.price-tag.large-price{background:#fff0a8;color:#725700;border:1px solid #eadb91}
.size-label{display:inline-block;margin-top:8px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:20px;font-size:9px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.6px}
.small-label{background:#eaf6ff;color:#245a73}
.large-label{background:#fff0a8;color:#725700}
.item .price{margin-top:5px}
 .team-photo-card{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-around;gap:16px}.team-member{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:9px;min-width:0;text-align:center}.team-member img{width:104px;height:104px;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #e4c8d8}.team-member .profile-copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}.team-member .profile-copy strong{color:#60465a}.team-member .profile-copy small{color:#947d8c}@media(max-width:600px){.team-photo-card{gap:8px}.team-member img{width:78px;height:78px}}
</style></head>

<section class="preorder" id="preorder" style="background:#fff4b8;border:1px solid #eadb91;padding:34px 20px;">
  <div class="kicker">make it yours &amp; pre-order</div>
  <h2>Custom &amp; Pre-Order Pin</h2>
  <p style="max-width:640px;margin:0 auto 20px;">
    Mau <strong>Custom Pin</strong> (desain bebas atau nama band sendiri) maupun <strong>Pre-Order koleksi pin</strong> langsung dari katalog website? Cek panduan di bawah sebelum order ya!
  </p>
  <div style="max-width:680px;margin:0 auto 24px;background:#fffdf5;border:2px dashed #c49a00;border-radius:18px;padding:18px 20px;text-align:left;box-shadow:0 4px 12px #0000000a;">
    <div style="text-align:center;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;color:#171717;margin-bottom:10px;letter-spacing:.3px;">
      ⚠️ Sebelum order, baca panduan berikut ⚠️
    </div>
    <ul style="margin:0;padding-left:20px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.7;color:#292929;">

<script>
function setCategory(category, button) {
  document.querySelectorAll('#filters .filter').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  button.classList.add('active');
  document.querySelectorAll('#productGrid .item').forEach(card => {
    card.style.display = (category === 'All' || card.dataset.category === category) ? '' : 'none';
  });
}
function toggleStatus(button) {
  const sold = button.textContent.trim() !== 'SOLD OUT';
  button.textContent = sold ? 'SOLD OUT' : 'AVAILABLE';
  button.classList.toggle('sold', sold);
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pincredibleStatuses') || '{}');
    saved[button.dataset.name] = sold ? 'sold' : 'available';
    localStorage.setItem('pincredibleStatuses', JSON.stringify(saved));
  } catch(e) {}
}
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  try {
    const saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('pincredibleStatuses') || '{}');
    document.querySelectorAll('#productGrid .status').forEach(button => {
      if (saved[button.dataset.name] === 'sold') {
        button.textContent = 'SOLD OUT';
        button.classList.add('sold');
      }
    });
  } catch(e) {}
});
</script>
